newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals end above lows after gold slump.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals end above lows after gold slump.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures ended well above session lows Wednesday after spot gold prices slid to test the 46-month low set in January.

"But the lows seen in January in spot gold held, silver failed to follow gold lower, and the bullion houses are still reporting good physical demand at these levels," Chase Manhattan New York managing director Dinsa Mehta said.
"So it's possible the market is putting down a marker about where the lows for the year are likely to be," he added.
